data.title: 祀 · 厨房灶台前尝一口热汤
data.action: 手持木勺凑唇吹气尝汤
data.description: 【祀 · 厨房灶台前尝一口热汤】傍晚的厨房里飘散着浓郁的鲜汤香气，祀系着松绿条纹围裙，一手轻轻挽起袖口，另一手拿着木汤勺凑在唇边轻轻吹气。转头看见你进门，眼底满是轻快笑意——「回来得正好，汤刚刚煨好，替我尝尝咸淡如何？」
data.promptProse: Standing beside the stove in her green striped apron, Si gently blows steam from a wooden ladle held near her lips, glancing over her shoulder with an affectionate expression.
data.animaCaption: She blows gently on the steaming ladle before turning her eyes toward the viewer with a welcoming smile.
